rnsMetadata.runnerForm: Beaten as favourite when fourth over 1250m at Kempsey, finishing just under four lengths from Just One Look after jumping awkwardly and working home evenly from a prominent spot. From barrier one he should be able to use his natural speed, and the claim helps under 62.5kg. The 62.5kg is the query, even with the claim.
